questions.prompt: Yesterday, I ___ a new book at the store.
questions.explanation: buy是不规则动词，过去式是bought。

questions.prompt: She ___ to the park last Sunday.
questions.explanation: go是不规则动词，过去式是went。
eat是不规则动词，过去式是ate。

questions.prompt: Last night, we ___ the room before our guests arrived. (clean)
questions.explanation: Last night 和 arrived 都把情境放在过去。clean 是规则动词，加 -ed 得到 cleaned，表示已经打扫了房间。
questions.evidence: clean → cleaned; Last night, we cleaned the room before our guests arrived.

questions.explanation: see是不规则动词，过去式是saw。

questions.prompt: Yesterday, I ___ my keys on the table.
questions.explanation: put的过去式还是put，是不规则动词。

questions.prompt: 用表示时间顺序“然后”的词连接：First, we visited the museum. ___, we had lunch.
questions.explanation: 本题指定“然后”这一时间顺序，选 Then；But 表转折，Because 表原因，不表达指定的顺序关系。

questions.prompt: 用表示“在那之后”的短语连接：She called her friend. ___, she went home.
questions.explanation: After that 对应“在那之后”。So 表示结果，Before 表示此前；题目要求时间顺序而非原因结果，不能仅凭两句先后猜连接词。

title: The Wrong Hotel Booking · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
一般过去时用来描述过去发生的动作或状态。规则动词的过去式通常在词尾加-ed，例如：book → booked, arrive → arrived, check → checked。不规则动词的过去式需要单独记忆，例如：go → went, take → took, make → made, say → said, see → saw, pay → paid, choose → chose。表示顺序时，可以用then（然后）、after that（之后）、finally（最后）来连接动作。 本组也练习 buy → bought、eat → ate 和 put → put；put 的过去式与原形拼写、读音都相同，要结合过去时间判断。

First, we went to a café and sat down. Then I called the hotel.
